title: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.18598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only $10$ to $20\%$ of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map

translated_title: 重新思考多模态大语言模型中的投影器训练
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型通常的训练流程是：首先在大规模图像-文本描述数据集上通过投影器训练将视觉编码器与语言模型对齐，随后对完整的多模态模型进行联合训练。尽管这一方法被广泛使用，投影器训练阶段的作用仍知之甚少。我们发现：(i) 仅使用10%到20%的数据训练投影器即可恢复大部分下游性能增益；(ii) 在不同数据集上训练的投影器可以进行线性插值，同时基本保持性能。这些结果表明，投影器训练主要执行的是一种粗略对齐，而许多不同的投影器都能同样好地实现这一目标。基于这些发现，我们提出了PORTAL，一种无需训练的投影器初始化方法，它既不需要成对的图像-文本描述数据，也不需要基于梯度的优化，而只需要每个模态的汇总统计量。PORTAL计算一个基于最优传输的映射……
tldr: 多模态大语言模型中的投影器训练主要起粗对齐作用，少量数据即可实现大部分效果，据此提出无需训练、仅依赖各模态汇总统计量的投影器初始化方法PORTAL。
en_tdlr: Projector training in multimodal LLMs mainly performs coarse alignment achievable with only a fraction of the data, motivating PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, only per-modality summary statistics.
